name: Clovette · Gremlet #28
description:
A four-leaf clover spirit. Finding it is lucky; being found is its favourite game.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Clovette in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
